character: tall spotted giraffe in a loose grey tie at a white mailbox on a post; the neck sweeps like a crane arm, forelegs splay to reach the ground; he fills two thirds of the frame in every window
cast: one darker giraffe without a tie; it works large at the lens, never still, never talks
motion_rule: the tied giraffe is the subject of every window, the other adds to his move; no window ends in a pose; shot size never repeats
props: one paper bill roll printed with big dark columns of digits down its whole length; the mailbox lid claps
environment: noon savanna, pale dry sand, acacia, bleached sky, hard white sun; sand fills the lower half

audio.delivery: male voice, bored deadpan, steady 4.4 syllables per second, never drawn out, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: налоги is na-LO-gi; мелочь is ME-loch; пузатая is pu-ZA-ta-ya; наклоняться is na-klo-NYAT-sa
audio.pacing: one phrase from 0.6 to 6.8, no breath at any join, nothing said after 6.8
audio.lip_sync: jaw and lips shape every syllable, never a voice-over

timeline.a: his head drops from the top of the frame in a long arc, the lid claps open under his muzzle and the digit roll bursts out into the lens
timeline.c: macro on the box, ripped up with his head

timeline.a: his tongue hooks the roll out and it drops open down his whole neck, digits running past the lens, the other giraffe shoving its muzzle into the falling paper
he throws his head up and the paper snaps straight along the neck, the other giraffe hanging off the loose end at the lens
timeline.c: wide, pulls back with the snap

timeline.a: he swings the neck sideways in a wide arc, the digit sheet sweeping over the sand and slapping the lens, the other giraffe chasing it
his forelegs slide wide apart and he shakes the open paper down its length, sand kicking into the lens
he folds the whole neck to the sand, muzzle grinding along the ground, the other giraffe at the lens pushing his head lower
timeline.c: sand level, slides under his jaw

timeline.a: he rolls the digit sheet into a tight scroll at blinding speed with neck and tongue, digits blurring past the lens, the post shuddering
he swallows the scroll whole and the lump travels the full length of his neck, the other giraffe pressing its ear to the neck at the lens to hear it go down
the lid blows open and a paper avalanche pours over both of them, digits filling the frame, burying him to the eyes
timeline.c: wide, driven back by the paper

timeline.a: only his head is above the drift, a strip of digits draped over his eyes, he chews it flat and the lid claps once more behind him
timeline.c: macro on his face, slides in

must_appear: big dark digits printed down the whole roll, readable in the first and last second; the paper snapping straight along the neck; the neck folded to the sand; the lump travelling down the neck; the paper avalanche burying him; the last frame is his head in the drift under a strip of digits
negative_prompt: night, dusk, dim light, underexposed, a blank paper roll, letters or words on the paper, Cyrillic writing, currency symbols, static camera, cuts, whip pan, a talking head, a still neck, the second giraffe frozen or out of frame, subtitles, watermark, English speech, voice-over, slow speech, drawn-out vowels, pauses between lines, the phrase repeated, any word after 6.8, a third giraffe, extra limbs, deformed anatomy, duplicate props
